title: Naira Money: Coins and Notes
seo_title: Naira Money – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Know Nigerian coins and notes up to ₦50; say which is worth more; count small amounts; buy things and find change. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: name naira coins and notes, which is worth more, count money to ₦50 and buy things. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Look at the number on the money
key_sub: A ₦20 note is worth more than a ₦5 coin.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • The number on a coin or note tells how much it is worth.
  • A big coin is not always worth more. Read the number.
  • To count money, start with the biggest one and count on.

Examples

Example

A ₦10 note and a ₦5 coin. How much?

Start with ₦10

Count on 5: ₦15

Answer: ₦15

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting the coins, not the nairaTwo coins can be ₦7, not 2.
Thinking a bigger coin is worth moreRead the number on it.
Forgetting the ₦ signWrite ₦15, not just 15.

faq.a: ₦1 and ₦2 coins; ₦5 and more are notes or coins.
Start with the biggest and count on.
